# Pulsarium

> Pulsarium is an independent stock and ETF portfolio tracker and financial news platform for individual investors. It provides a free stock market news dashboard at pulsarium.finance and a free personal account at app.pulsarium.finance for tracking portfolios, dividends, watchlists and price alerts. Users record transactions manually or import broker export files; their investments remain with their chosen broker. Paid tiers with an AI research assistant are planned.

## Personal cabinet (app.pulsarium.finance, free beta)
- Portfolio tracking: several portfolios in different currencies, positions, weights, performance over time, per-position weight limits.
- Dividends and stock splits: detected automatically and applied after the investor confirms them; dividend history per holding.
- Broker file import: transaction exports from Fidelity, Charles Schwab, Vanguard, Robinhood, E*TRADE, Merrill Edge, Webull, M1 Finance, Firstrade and Interactive Brokers (IBKR activity statements) in the US, Freetrade, Trading 212, Revolut, DEGIRO, Saxo and XTB in the UK and Europe, and Zerodha in India, plus CSV or TSV files from other brokers with column mapping (remembered per file format). No broker login or credentials are needed — only the exported file.
- Watchlists with price alerts above or below a level, with email notifications.
- Signal Feed: news filtered to the investor's holdings and watchlists.
- Company pages: one page per stock with price history, the investor's position, price alerts, private notes and news; for US-listed companies, key figures from SEC filings (revenue, margins, P/E, balance sheet, cash flow) and dividend per share by year.
- Privacy and security: two-factor authentication (TOTP), Google sign-in, row-level data isolation, full data export and self-service account deletion.
- Market data may be delayed.

## News (pulsarium.finance)
- [Live news dashboard](https://pulsarium.finance/news/): stock market headlines aggregated from public sources (Yahoo Finance, CNBC, MarketWatch, Nasdaq, Investing.com, CoinDesk and sector outlets), tagged by ticker and sector and scored for sentiment and importance. Refreshes throughout the trading day.
- [News by company and sector](https://pulsarium.finance/news/companies/): one page per company (e.g. [Nvidia](https://pulsarium.finance/news/nvda/)) and per sector with the last 30 days of headlines and a sentiment summary.
- [Daily digest](https://pulsarium.finance/news/daily/): each day's top stories, sentiment and most mentioned companies.
- [RSS feed](https://pulsarium.finance/news/feed.xml) of the latest headlines.
- [Pulsarium Mood Index](https://pulsarium.finance/mood/): a daily 0-100 score of how positive the day's stock market headlines are (50 = neutral), with history as [JSON](https://pulsarium.finance/mood/history.json) and sector moods.

## Market data pages
- [Market Universe](https://pulsarium.finance/universe/): an interactive 3D map of about 300 of the largest US-listed companies — each company a star, each sector a galaxy — built from SEC filings: revenue growth, margins and cash-flow signals, with end-of-day prices and price correlations between companies.
- [Q3 2026 earnings season in one picture](https://pulsarium.finance/earnings-season/): 744 US companies worth $10 billion or more and each stock's move on the first trading day after its Q3 2026 earnings report, grouped by date, result (beat or missed forecasts) and sector. A dated snapshot of reports from October 12 to November 13, 2026.
- [Insider buying this week](https://pulsarium.finance/insider-buying/): stock purchases by company officers and directors in the last 7 days from SEC Form 4 filings — the largest purchases and the stocks several insiders bought. Updated twice a day.
- [Insider selling this week](https://pulsarium.finance/insider-selling/): stock sales by company officers and directors in the last 7 days from SEC Form 4 filings — the largest sales and the stocks several insiders sold, with sales under 10b5-1 trading plans marked. Updated twice a day.
- [US sector analytics](https://pulsarium.finance/sector-analytics/): revenue growth, operating margins and insider trades for US industries from the companies' latest SEC reports. Updated twice a day.
- [Report highlights](https://pulsarium.finance/report-highlights/): signals from the latest SEC reports — profit versus cash flow, dividend and buyback coverage, inventories and receivables, profit turnarounds, buybacks and share dilution, financial stress. Updated twice a day.
- [IPO lock-up calendar](https://pulsarium.finance/lock-up-calendar/): lock-up expiration dates for every US IPO since November 2025 that raised $1 billion or more (SpaceX, Anthropic, Cerebras, Medline, INNIO, Quantinuum, Bending Spoons and others). For each release step: the first day the shares may be sold, the number of shares, their share of the company and the trigger (fixed day, earnings report or price test), read by hand from each final prospectus (Form 424B4) on SEC EDGAR; the data as [JSON](https://pulsarium.finance/assets/lockups.json). Not investment advice.

## Guides and tools
- Cabinet features: [portfolio tracker](https://pulsarium.finance/portfolio-tracker/), [dividend tracker](https://pulsarium.finance/dividend-tracker/), [price alerts](https://pulsarium.finance/price-alerts/), [why Pulsarium](https://pulsarium.finance/why-pulsarium/).
- [Broker import guides](https://pulsarium.finance/import/): step by step for Fidelity, Charles Schwab, Vanguard, Robinhood, E*TRADE, Merrill Edge, Webull, M1 Finance, Firstrade, Interactive Brokers, Freetrade, Trading 212, Revolut, DEGIRO, Saxo, XTB and Zerodha.
- [Free calculators](https://pulsarium.finance/tools/): dividend yield, DCA (monthly investing) and portfolio rebalancing.
